dog.description_text:
Lady is a 3 year old Beagle mix who weighs around 21 lbs, and she really is as sweet as they come! This lovely girl is already house-trained and crate-trained, and she loves people of all ages. She's the kind of dog that makes us think whoever gets to adopt her is going to be very lucky!

Lady can be a little shy when meeting other dogs, but it doesn't take her long to warm up once she's had a chance to get to know them. She's such a sweetheart, and we can't wait for her to find a family that will give her all the love she deserves!

Registered adopters interested in Lady can email adopt@hbrdogs.com for more info. If you're not registered yet, do it today at hbrdogs.com!
